provenance.source_title: Why Did Ancient Humans Enter the Frozen North

examples.psychological_goal: 第一句用否定-肯定对仗击碎观众的默认想象，制造必须解释的认知缺口
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定常识断言 + 肯定反常事实的双句反转
examples.example_text: The first humans who entered the frozen north were not lost. They kept going back.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句反转断言替代铺垫：先否定观众心中的默认剧本，再抛出反常事实
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景与措辞；反转必须针对目标主题真实的默认误解

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代产品错位制造笑点，同时凸显史前壮举的不可思议
examples.expression_mechanism: 现代产品词（weather app）+ 文明里程碑排比 + 成熟决定式冷评
examples.example_text: before anyone could open a weather app, C minus 40, and make the mature decision to remain indoors.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在严肃排比的末尾嵌入一个现代参照，让敬畏与笑点同时落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该参照物；错位词必须与主题场景天然契合

examples.psychological_goal: 把叙事从挣扎求生翻转为经营获利，一句话落定全片论题
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定对仗 + 经济学动词（profitable）重构
examples.example_text: Humans did not simply survive the North. They discovered how to make the North profitable.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一对短句把主题从被动框架翻转到主动框架
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；翻转动词必须与主题的资源逻辑相符

examples.psychological_goal: 在提醒幸存者偏差时用一句黑色幽默让方法论提醒变得可记
examples.expression_mechanism: 三组并列失败案例 + 末尾荒诞定性（extremely brief archaeology）
examples.example_text: that turned back, the camp erased by a river, or the group that underestimated winter and became extremely brief archaeology.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在列举沉重事实的末尾用一个冷面定性完成笑点与警示双功能
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该定性句；幽默不能削弱对失败者的尊重

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句格言翻转丰度定义，论证少数物种也能构成富足
examples.expression_mechanism: 具体画面铺垫 + 否定-肯定格言句（不需要 X，需要 Y）
examples.example_text: several tons of meat directly on the horizon. For a skilled hunter, abundance did not need variety. It needed hooves.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给画面再给格言：格言必须压缩前文论证而非空喊
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象；格言的名词必须来自前文的画面

examples.psychological_goal: 在第一层答案落地后立刻打开新缺口，制造递进悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: But + alone was not enough 缺口句式 + 生理约束解释
examples.example_text: But meat alone was not enough. A person cannot live indefinitely on extremely lean protein.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用缺口句式把每个答案变成下一个问题的入口
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用句式；缺口必须是真实存在的约束

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个经济学隐喻完成资源价值的重构定性
examples.expression_mechanism: X was the true [地域] currency 隐喻断言句
examples.example_text: Fat was the true northern currency.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句隐喻断言为整个段落的经济逻辑定调
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该隐喻；隐喻必须能贯穿后文的机制解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代餐桌视角的反差完成三分法定性，笑点与结构感兼得
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定现代分类 + 三分法清单定性（now, later, material）
examples.example_text: An Ice Age carcass was not divided into steak and everything embarrassing. It was divided into energy now, energy later, and material.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定一个观众熟悉的分类法，再给出承载主题逻辑的三分法
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该分类内容；三分法必须是真实的分析框架

examples.psychological_goal: 把一件小工具的分量抬到生死量级，论证工艺升级的历史重量
examples.expression_mechanism: 两个近义状态的对照 + decided who could 式命运断言
examples.example_text: The difference between wearing an animal and wearing a coat may have decided who could remain north.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一对近义对照词揭示微小改进背后的巨大后果
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对照；对照双方必须是观众原以为相同的事物

examples.psychological_goal: 把生存从一次性成就重构为日复一日的维护，引发敬意
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定对仗 + 动词（stitched）呼应前文工艺意象
examples.example_text: Cold weather survival was not achieved once. It was stitched back together every day.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用动词回扣前文细节，让定性句与论证肌理缝合
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该动词意象；定性必须建立在前文铺垫之上

examples.psychological_goal: 用拟人化冷评点破后勤的重要性，让教训可复述
examples.expression_mechanism: 环境拟人化 + 华丽与卑微的对照（equipment vs sticks）
examples.example_text: The North punished specialists who remembered the glamorous equipment, and forgot the sticks.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用拟人化判词把后勤教训压缩成一句可复述的警句
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该拟人对象；警句必须对应前文的论证

examples.psychological_goal: 完成全片中枢认知翻转：适应的本质是社会系统而非身体
examples.expression_mechanism: The true X was not A. It was B. 的对仗揭示句
examples.example_text: The true northern adaptation was therefore not thick skin. It was other humans.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用对仗句把答案从物质层翻到社会层，一击完成翻转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式内容；翻转方向必须由前文证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 把日常物件重构为生死计时器，为再设问蓄足情绪
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定对仗 + 时间隐喻（countdown）
examples.example_text: A damaged boot was not an inconvenience. It was a countdown.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在列举代价的末尾用一个隐喻把最小物件放大成生死
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该隐喻；隐喻必须精确对应前文的危险机制

examples.psychological_goal: 用荒诞的现代战略图景反证渐进扩张模型
examples.expression_mechanism: No one + 现代机构腔（strategic plan）+ 荒谬时限（by Thursday）
examples.example_text: No one stood in Central Asia and announced a strategic plan to occupy the Arctic by Thursday.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句没有人做过的荒诞画面来论证渐进机制
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景；荒诞画面必须服务论点而非单纯搞笑

examples.psychological_goal: 把失败证据升格为对直线进步神话的正面击碎
examples.expression_mechanism: This is not a footnote 升格句 + 神话拆穿断言
examples.example_text: This is not a footnote. It destroys the comforting myth that humans conquered nature in one uninterrupted advance.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先为证据升格（不是脚注），再点明它摧毁的神话
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该断言；被摧毁的神话必须是观众真实持有的

examples.psychological_goal: 用速度对照一句话落定文化对基因的胜利
examples.expression_mechanism: 机制约束陈述 + 三词格言判决（outran）
examples.example_text: A genetic adaptation must spread through descendants. Culture outran anatomy.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先陈述约束条件，再用极短格言句完成判决
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该格言；判决动词必须体现对照维度

examples.psychological_goal: 把地理空间升格为文化家园，完成主题的人文化
examples.expression_mechanism: X became human when + 获得性条件（memory）
examples.example_text: The North became human when it acquired memory.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个获得性条件把空间变成家园，一句话完成升格
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式意象；条件必须是前文展示过的积累

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连拆件句展示系统脆弱性，笑点中完成系统思维
examples.expression_mechanism: X without Y is Z 格言 + 荒诞后果画面
examples.example_text: Fire without fuel is optimism. Weapons without cooperation can leave a hunter facing several tons of irritated mammoth alone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同构排比逐件拆除系统零件，最后一件用画面收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该排比内容；每件零件必须对应前文论证过的层

examples.psychological_goal: 用克制的转折句确认胜利的边界，避免廉价凯旋
examples.expression_mechanism: 承认旧事实 + simply stopped 转折限定
examples.example_text: The frozen north still killed people. It simply stopped being able to stop all of them.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在胜利时刻先承认代价仍然存在，再给限定性胜利
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该表述；限定必须是真实的而非修辞谦虚

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定动机加肯定目标的清单与一句格言收束全片
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定对仗 + 四连名词清单 + 门票隐喻格言
examples.example_text: Ancient humans did not walk north in search of misery. They walked toward animals, territory, materials, and possibility. The ice was the cost of admission.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾三段式：先否定悲情叙事，再给正向清单，最后格言压缩全片
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单与格言；隐喻必须能概括全片的代价逻辑
